profile: AI engineer and full-stack developer focused on building intelligent, production-ready applications, integrating large language models, agents, and automation into scalable, maintainable systems. Experienced across frontend and backend development with a strong grounding in .NET and modern web stacks, and a proven ability to pick up new tools and frameworks on the fly. A confident communicator with a military-trained mindset that thrives in high-pressure, mission-critical environments where precision and execution matter.

sourceNotes: Merged with content from the live portfolio's src/app/data/*.data.ts.
Date discrepancies between the CV PDF and the portfolio data: MWSC start (CV 2024-04 vs portfolio 2024-03); IT Technician end (CV 2016-02 vs portfolio 2018). CV values retained above.

The portfolio's education.data lists several older training certificates (e.g. Basic Seamanship 1994, Diesel Engine Repair 1998, Airport Emergency Exercise 1999) whose dates predate the 1996 date of birth; these appear to be placeholder/erroneous records and were omitted from certifications pending verification.
